meaning:
κύλισμα, -τος, τό
(κυλίω), [in Sm.: Eze.10:13 * ;]
1. a roll.
2. = κυλισμός (which see), a rolling, wallowing (or, as κυλίστρα, Xen., Eq., see 3, a rolling place): 2Pe.2:22 (Rec.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
